title: Riot X Nic Salts Sour Pineapple Razz 10ml E-Liquid
description: Sour Pineapple Razz from Riot X is a bold fusion of tropical tang and berry sharpness. This e-liquid balances the juicy sweetness of ripe pineapple with a punchy raspberry twist, creating a lively contrast of sweet and sour notes. The bright fruit flavours are layered with a subtle tartness that keeps each inhale fresh and invigorating. Part of Riot Squad’s Riot X collection, this e-liquid is designed to deliver the intense, double-concentrated flavours found in the most popular single-use disposables. Supplied in a 10ml bottle, it’s an ideal option for vapers transitioning from disposables to refillable MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits, offering the same bold taste experience with added convenience and cost efficiency. Riot X Salt E-Liquids are made with Riot Squad’s Hybrid Nicotine blend, a combination of freebase nicotine and nicotine salts. This innovative mix, along with the 50PG/50VG ratio, ensures a well-balanced vape with vibrant flavour, a smooth throat hit, and satisfying vapour production. Please note: this flavour profile may contain hints of 'ice'.
